selector: RUNTIME_PROFILE is the single authoritative composition selector; APP_ENV and DATA_MODE must match the selected profile and cannot independently enable capabilities.
rule: A missing, unknown or conflicting RUNTIME_PROFILE/APP_ENV/DATA_MODE combination is rejected before listening or connecting with a mutating role. Test and demo accept only synthetic data. Staging and production require approved residency, approved non-test key provider and privacy controls before readiness. VITE_DEMO is presentation-only. Demo authorization is server-side and never provides general tenant or purge authority.
